QUOTE: `scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans `include/mbedtls/*.h` with a regex for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<NAME> -0x....`. ... and writes the result into `library/error.c` through the template `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template, and says not to hand-edit it.
